tasks.short: Signal locomotive engineers during coupling or uncoupling

steps.actor: railroad brake signal and switch operator
inputs: Actual train, cars, crew and movement conditions
outputs: Checked intended signal for the actual immediate situation or a decision to hold

inputs: Exact signal and current situation checked in s1
Existing signalling lantern or railway radio, defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual immediate signal communicated to the locomotive engineer

tasks.short: Monitor trains around curves for dragging equipment and smoking journal boxes

steps.what: Observe the actual train as it rounds curves, maintaining the required view of equipment and journal boxes
steps.actor: railroad brake signal and switch operator
inputs: Actual moving train and sight lines
outputs: Actual visual observations and visibility limitations

steps.what: Assess the actual observations for dragging equipment or smoking journal boxes and recognise uncertain or concerning conditions
steps.actor: railroad brake signal and switch operator
inputs: Actual train observations and visibility limitations from s1
outputs: Human assessment of observed defects or uncertainty

tasks.design: Retain actual curve observation and defect assessment. A new {OTHER} detector installation is not established as a substitute for this continuous task by the available evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Detection depends on actual sight lines, equipment condition and the moving train.

tasks.still_hard: Intermittent visibility and uncertain visual signs require immediate human attention.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an unusual actual condition and the limits of what can be seen.

ambition.what: Retain this observation duty until a validated replacement is demonstrated.
